title: Reviews
description: What patients said about your visits. Read-only: you cannot reply, hide or change reviews here.
synthetic: Synthetic data for testing only. These reviews are made up for testing.
gated: Reviews are switched off in this workspace until the feature is approved and enabled.

empty.title: No reviews yet
empty.body: When patients review a completed visit, it appears here after moderation.

summary.title: Overall
summary.average: {count, plural, one {out of 5, from # published review} other {out of 5, from # published reviews}}
summary.note: Only reviews published by moderation count. Patients are never named here.

hidden.pending_moderation: The rating and text appear here once moderation publishes this review.
hidden.rejected: Moderation did not publish this review, so its rating and text are not shown.
